description: This file implements a plugin class 'OCIContainer' for managing OCI containers within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It handles container lifecycle operations such as listing, starting, stopping, pausing, resuming, and executing commands inside containers, as well as handling events for container state changes. The plugin communicates with Dobby proxies and OMI proxies for container management and enforces security checks like volume encryption. It exposes RPC methods, manages internal state, and facilitates event notifications.

classes.name: OCIContainer
classes.description: A plugin class that manages OCI container lifecycle and events, exposing RPC methods for container operations within WPEFramework.

methods.name: listContainers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of currently running containers from Dobby.

methods.name: getContainerState
methods.description: Gets the current state of a specified container.

methods.name: getContainerInfo
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specified container.

methods.name: startContainer
methods.description: Starts a new container from an OCI bundle with specified parameters.

methods.name: startContainerFromDobbySpec
methods.description: Starts a container using a provided Dobby spec string and container ID.

methods.name: stopContainer
methods.description: Stops a running container, with optional force parameter.

methods.name: executeCommand
methods.description: Executes a command inside a container.

methods.name: onContainerStarted
methods.description: Sends a notification that a container has started.

methods.name: onContainerStopped
methods.description: Sends a notification that a container has stopped.

methods.name: onContainerFailed
methods.description: Sends a notification that a container failed, e.g., due to verity check failure.
